tagline: Global leader in agricultural, turf, construction, and forestry equipment
hero_kpi_rationale: Master financial performance and commercial health indicator, reflecting the combined dynamics of the four operating segments (PPA, SAT, CF, FS)

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total net sales and revenues across all operating segments
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales of the company

kpis.name: PPA Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Production Precision Agriculture segment including 4WD/track and row crop tractors, harvesters, and specialty equipment
kpis.description: Revenue from the Production Precision Agriculture segment covering 4WD/track and row crop tractors, harvesters, and specialty equipment

kpis.name: Agriculture and Turf Sales
kpis.explanation: Combined sales from Production Precision Agriculture and Small Agriculture Turf segments
kpis.description: Combined sales from the Agriculture and Turf segments (PPA and SAT)

kpis.name: Construction and Forestry Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Construction Forestry segment including earthmoving, forestry, and roadbuilding equipment
kpis.description: Revenue from the Construction Forestry segment covering earthmoving, forestry, and roadbuilding equipment

ai_positioning.summary: Deere integrates automation, autonomy, and digitalization into equipment and service solutions, with emphasis on deeper technology integration to enable customers to do more with less. SaaS products represent emerging revenue stream.
evidence: Refined Leap Ambitions in December 2025 emphasizing automation, autonomy, digitalization, lifecycle solutions, and Solutions as a Service
Smart Industrial Operating Model supporting product quality and manufacturing excellence
Deeper integration of technology into equipment for improved profitability, productivity, and sustainability
